proposals.evidence: Turner *śāṭayati explicitly gives Awankari sāṛuṇ, Lahnda sāṛaṇ and Punjabi sāṛnā transitive burn. These northwestern wood-burning commands match that family; the occasional short-vowel or n spelling is retained as a qualified survey variant, not silently normalized.
